exercises.why: **выписала** — вы́писать (perfective): to sign out; to subscribe (e.g. to a magazine); to write, to write out, to write down; to copy. Wiktionary: вы́- + писа́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to describe, to depict, to portray (to represent in words)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: опи́сывать — to describe, to depict, to portray (to represent in words); подписа́ть — to sign (one's own name); вы́писать — to sign out; припи́сывать — to add (by writing).

exercises.q: This poem is attributed to him.
exercises.why: **приписывают** — припи́сывать (imperfective): to add (by writing); to attach, to register; to arrogate, to ascribe, to attribute, to impute. Wiktionary: приписа́ть + -ывать.

exercises.why: **записывал** — запи́сывать (imperfective): to write down, to enter (to set something down in writing); to record (to make a record of information; to make an audio or video recording of); to enroll, to register (to enlist (someone) or make (someone) a member of); (computing, rare) to save (to write a file to a disk). Wiktionary: записа́ть + -ывать.

correspondence (reciprocal exchange of letters, emails, etc.)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: запи́сывать — to write down, to enter (to set something down in writing); перепи́ска — correspondence (reciprocal exchange of letters, emails, etc.); вы́писка — writing out, copying; пи́саный — (colloquial) written down, fixed in writing.
